title: Testing a Later Club Start Time
topic: a school testing a later start time for after-school clubs during the hottest months
topicJa: 学校が暑い時期に部活動の開始時刻を遅らせて試すこと
benefit: students may avoid the strongest heat and have time to drink water and rest after classes
benefitJa: 生徒が最も強い暑さを避け、授業後に水分補給と休憩の時間を取れること
challenge: a later finish can affect buses, family schedules, and the amount of daylight available for outdoor practice
challengeJa: 終了時刻が遅くなるとバスや家庭の予定、屋外練習に使える日照時間へ影響する可能性があります

title: Repairing Before Replacing
topic: a community center teaching residents how to repair simple household items before replacing them
topicJa: 地域センターが住民に家庭用品を買い替える前の簡単な修理方法を教えること
benefit: participants can save money, reduce waste, and understand how everyday objects are made
benefitJa: 参加者が費用とごみを減らし、身近な物の仕組みを理解できること
challenge: some damaged products are unsafe to repair without expert knowledge and suitable tools
challengeJa: 壊れた製品の中には専門知識や適切な道具なしで修理すると危険なものがあります

title: Students Record Local Sounds
topic: students recording everyday sounds to create an audio map of their town
topicJa: 生徒が日常の音を録音して町の音の地図を作ること
benefit: the project helps students notice how places change by time, activity, and season
benefitJa: 時間や活動、季節によって場所がどう変化するか生徒が気づけること
challenge: recordings can include private conversations, so students need clear rules about consent and location
challengeJa: 録音に私的な会話が入る可能性があるため、同意や録音場所について明確なルールが必要です

title: A Week Without Printed Handouts
topic: a class testing one week with fewer printed handouts and more shared digital materials
topicJa: あるクラスが印刷物を減らし共有デジタル教材を増やす一週間を試すこと
benefit: the class can measure paper use and learn which materials are genuinely easier to manage digitally
benefitJa: 紙の使用量を測り、どの教材が本当にデジタル管理しやすいか学べること
challenge: device access, eye strain, and technical problems may make digital materials less convenient for some students
challengeJa: 端末利用、目の疲れ、技術的問題により一部の生徒にはデジタル教材が不便になる可能性があります
